summary: Going Down's first research night: a teardown of Cutaway Instinct and From The Ground Up, 2 new topics (Derinkuyu, Kolkata's under-river metro), a demand reference added to SoFi, every open topic tagged with its dive format, 1 hook challenger and 1 trial shape.
why: No channel numbers yet. Demand: Derinkuyu 2.5M on a 77K channel, Kolkata's underwater metro 3.7M on 638K. Cutaway Instinct has drifted to brand and stadium explainers (most 5-50K), while From The Ground Up's hidden-space Shorts reach 1.3-16M.

findings.title: Cutaway Instinct has left 'what's under' for brands and stadiums
findings.detail: Most of its last 40 Shorts get 5-50K views; its one recent 'What's Under' Short got 6.2K. The pure dive is less contested than we thought.

findings.title: Hidden-space promises carry From The Ground Up
findings.detail: Hidden Room 16M, Secret Hideout 1.7M, Secret Bunker 1.4M, Underground City 1.3M on 81K subs.

findings.title: The Paris Catacombs are a breakout too, but need sourcing
findings.detail: 1.8M views on an 83K channel. Only the 20 m depth is sourced, so it's held out of the feed until 3 more depths are found.

changes.title: 2 topics added, SoFi reference added, 17 topics tagged with a format
